acs.text: A slot restricted to chosen Abhyasis is visible only to those chosen Abhyasis.

expected_answer.operand: viewers of a restricted slot are among its chosen Abhyasis

acs.text: Publishing a week sends each eligible Abhyasi one new-slots announcement email for that publication.

expected_answer.unit: email per eligible Abhyasi per publication

acs.text: A published week's announcement lists every newly visible slot eligible for that recipient.

expected_answer.operand: newly visible slots eligible for the recipient are listed in that recipient's announcement

acs.text: A single slot added later sends its own announcement to its eligible recipients.

expected_answer.operand: separate announcement for a single slot added later to each eligible recipient

acs.text: A slot's capacity cannot be set below 1 or above 50; an out-of-range value receives a validation error.

expected_answer.operand: validation error for slot capacity outside 1–50

acs.text: A slot's duration cannot be set below 5 or above 240 minutes; an out-of-range value receives a validation error.

expected_answer.operand: validation error for slot duration outside 5–240 minutes

acs.text: A slot's start time is entered with AM/PM in the preceptor's own timezone.

expected_answer.operand: slot start time entered with AM/PM in the preceptor's timezone

acs.text: Slot times are stored in UTC.

expected_answer.operand: UTC representation of the preceptor's entered time

acs.text: A new slot's duration defaults to 45 minutes.
A slot's duration can be changed per slot within 5–240 minutes.
A new slot's capacity defaults to 1 Abhyasi.
A slot can have capacity greater than 1 for a group sitting.
A slot defaults to visibility for all linked Abhyasis.

expected_answer.operand: linked Abhyasis may view an unrestricted slot

acs.text: Copying last week's plan creates that plan in the current week.

expected_answer.operand: current-week copy of last week's plan

judgements.rationale: Visibility is an auth and user-reach concern; copying risks lost planning data; announcements and slot settings affect recipients. No monetary behavior is specified; change frequency is not evidenced. These factors govern the run's combinatorial strength (3 when auth or data-loss applies).

Assumptions sweep: the product URL, preceptor credentials, linked seed users, and email inspection channel are not supplied; these will receive incomplete or unmeasurable gaps rather than invented facts. The owner's explicit bounds are authoritative even though they are absent from the requirements document.
